rationale:
## Campaign Rationale — 22 May 2026

The Chickpea / Uttar Pradesh segment (19 growers, avg score 0.328) was prioritised based on alignment between the current pod formation growth stage and a demonstrated WhatsApp engagement signal, making this a time-sensitive awareness window where growers are actively seeking crop protection guidance. **Actara 25 WG** was selected as the stage-aware recommendation for pod formation, where sucking pest pressure — particularly aphids and whiteflies — poses a direct yield risk, making thiamethoxam-based intervention messaging highly relevant and actionable at this moment. No OOS inventory blocks were triggered, meaning all 19 growers can be contacted without risk of generating demand against unavailable stock, and field teams can proceed with full confidence in fulfilment readiness. The expected outcome is a focused, low-friction awareness push across a modest but well-timed cohort, with field teams targeting a conversion lift driven by stage-matched messaging; given the 0.328 average score, realistic conversion expectations should remain measured, with success benchmarked against engagement response rates and follow-up scan or inquiry activity rather than immediate purchase closure.

अच्छी खबर है! Actara 25 WG इन सभी कीड़ों को मार देता है। बस पानी में मिलाकर छिड़काव करें। यह दवा पौधे के अंदर जाकर काम करती है।

अपने नजदीकी Syngenta डीलर से Actara माँगिए। आपकी फसल सुरक्षित रहेगी!
